sn35.105:1.1: kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
sn35.105:3.1: cakkhusmiṃ kho bhikkhave sati cakkhuṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ …pe…
sn35.105:3.2: jivhāya sati jivhaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ …pe… manamhi sati manaṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhaṃ.
sn35.105:5.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.105:7.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
sn35.105:11.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.105:13.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
sn35.105:17.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti.
sn35.105:19.1: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ api nu taṃ anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhadukkhanti.
sn35.105:21.1: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati …pe… jivhāyapi nibbindati manasmiṃpi nibbindati
sn35.105:21.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.105:21.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
